acceptedGaps.conditionNotModelled: Derivative aluminum articles of a country other than Russia in which any primary aluminum was smelted in Russia, or that were cast in Russia (U.S. note 19). The engine applies 9903.85.68 to products of Russia only; it does not ask where the aluminum was smelted or cast.
acceptedGaps.reason: Needs a smelt/cast-country question the calculator does not have yet. Goods that are the product of Russia are modelled in measures.json; the other-origin case is rare for the listed lines and is accepted until the question exists.

acceptedGaps.conditionNotModelled: Special-column entries that refer a trade program to a Chapter 98/99 provision instead of stating a rate ("See 9822.04.01-9822.04.03 (AU)", "See 9823.08.01-9823.08.38 (S+)", "See 9918.04.60, 9918.04.64 (CO)"): the FTA tariff-rate quotas and safeguards for dairy, sugar, beef, tobacco and similar goods. The in-quota rate depends on quota allocation and fill, which the calculator does not have.
acceptedGaps.reason: The engine never prices these silently: claimablePrograms() does not offer the claim, and a request that claims the program anyway fails with "Can't read the base rate". Without the claim the general (over-quota) rate is charged, which is correct when the shipment has no in-quota allocation and can only overstate duty otherwise. Accepted until in-quota FTA rates are modelled.
acceptedGaps.reviewedBy: issue #1794 rate-parse gate (proposed by the calculator agent; confirm in PR review)

acceptedGaps.ratePattern: The rate applicable to the natural juice in heading 2009
acceptedGaps.conditionNotModelled: 2106.90.52 / 2106.90.54 and 2202.99.36 / 2202.99.37 (juice concentrates and juice-based drinks) are dutiable at "the rate applicable to the natural juice in heading 2009" — which juice depends on the product, so the line has no rate of its own.
acceptedGaps.reason: The engine returns an error naming the referenced rate for these lines (never a guessed amount); the importer prices the matching heading 2009 juice line instead. Four lines; accepted until the calculator can ask which juice the product is made from.
